description: A protocol's fees and revenue per day (USD) for up to 3650 days, with the period's totals and its fees on each chain on the latest day; chain_history=yes adds each chain's daily series. Version-split parents (Uniswap) carry no chain split: ask for a version (uniswap-v3). fees ranks protocols by the latest day. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain_history.description: yes to add each chain's daily series over the same days.

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

slug.description: The project's slug; find it with find_projects or fees.
